interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Eats the same meal before every job â€” superstition masquerading as preference
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon â€” has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything â€” late once, nearly died, never again
Keeps a physical paper notebook â€” no digital record of personal thoughts
breaking_points: Losing their primary augmentation â€” the one that defines their professional identity
Their body rejecting their cyberware â€” chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario

physical_description.heritage: Eastern European and Middle Eastern dominant (69.7%), with significant Northern European (17.7%) and minor South Asian (9.8%) and Sub-Saharan African (2.8%) ancestry. The genetic blend creates a striking Eurasian phenotype â€” sharp Eastern European bone structure (high cheekbones, strong jaw) merged with Middle Eastern facial breadth and warmth. Northern European undertones cool the complexion while South Asian and African ancestry add subtle richness to skin depth and warmth. The synthesis produces a weathered Mediterranean-Caucasian appearance with Middle Eastern softness counterbalancing Slavic angularity.
physical_description.build: Compact and densely muscled, built low to the ground with a center of gravity that favors lateral movement and impact absorption. Shoulders broad relative to frame, legs thick and powerful. No excess fat â€” the physique of someone who treats their body as operational equipment.

Weathered from years of outdoor contract work with visible sun damage but resilient texture. The complexion carries genuine warmth despite cool undertones, distinctly Mediterranean rather than Scandinavian.
physical_description.complexion: Blended Eurasian features: high angular cheekbones with slight fullness through the midface typical of Middle Eastern ancestry, broad forehead, pronounced jawline characteristic of Eastern European heritage. Eyes set with moderate depth. Face marked by fine lines around eyes and mouth from years of tactical focus and squinting. Clean-shaven with visible five-o'clock shadow. Scar tissue visible along right jawline, thin and pale against warm skin tone. Skin texture weathered but maintained â€” evidence of functional discipline.

Neural interface jack at base of skull beneath close-cropped hair â€” visible as a small metallic disc when head is angled or hair shifts. Both modifications show functional age and routine maintenance rather than cosmetic polish.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision â€” no wasted motion, weight distributed low. Sits with back always to wall or corner. Right hand unconsciously rests near smartgun link integration point. Eyes track movement vectors in crowds. Walks with slight favoring of left leg during extended periods â€” residual compensation from old injury. Overall bearing suggests someone perpetually aware of nearest exits and vehicle trajectories.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical â€” reinforced synth-leather jacket in faded charcoal over smart-weave undershirt that monitors vitals. Heavy cargo pants with mag-sealed pockets and knee armor integration points. Steel-toed ankle boots with grip-sole designed for vehicle footwork. Minimal branding â€” function over identification. One piece of jewelry: worn titanium signet ring on left ring finger, inherited from his mentor. No visible corp-affiliation markers.
